name: Buildr
description: Buildr gives general contractors one connected place to run preconstruction — from relationships and pursuits through budgets, bids, workforce planning, forecasting, and AI-assisted work. Instead of managing precon across disconnected spreadsheets and point solutions, teams work from the same data, reduce accidental silos, and move faster with unlimited seats for the whole company.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Buildr to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Buildr to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.buildr.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Buildr MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Buildr provides these MCP tools: execute and search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Buildr?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Buildr in other on the Manufact MCP catalog include Muju, ZMAXINC, PGA – Play Golf, citytracker.ai, and Commonlands Optics: M12 Lens and C-Mount Lens Finder + Field-of-View Calculator.
Buildr requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Buildr is developed by Buildr. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
